name: Ultimate Online BallSync 2.0 receiving & pass-defence animation library

rig.axes: Y up, character faces +Z, +X = character left
rig.note: Measured from the supplied mesh (soles 0.6 to helmet top 45.8). The older tackle docs quoted 53 units; 45.2 is the measured value.

conventions.root_motion: In place: only Hips Y moves. The game owns world position, facing (root_turn_deg tells how far to turn the root inside root_turn_window_s) and jump height.
conventions.events: Seconds from the first exported frame. Also stored in each GLB as animation.extras.events. null = not applicable.
conventions.bobbles: Maximum one bobble per attempt: bobble clips have exactly one bobble_start/bobble_end pair.
conventions.ball: No football mesh in any file. The game attaches its own ball at possession.
